title: Design Studio Selections Payment Terms by Package: Methods, Card Limits and Fees
content:
Option deposits on a Design Studio Selections file are paid by the methods the package accepts. The package also sets the largest card payment accepted toward option deposits, the card convenience fee percentage and the package's returned payment fee.

| Package | Payment methods accepted for option deposits | Largest card payment accepted (USD) | Card convenience fee (percent of the card amount) | Returned payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | card, ACH, check | 5000.00 | 2.75 | 35.00 |
| Studio Classic | card, ACH, check | 5000.00 | 2.75 | 35.00 |
| Studio Select | card, ACH, check | 5000.00 | 2.75 | 35.00 |
| Studio Designer | ACH, check, wire | 5000.00 | 2.75 | 35.00 |
| Studio Signature | ACH, check, wire | 0.00 | 2.75 | 35.00 |
| Studio Atelier | ACH, check, wire | 0.00 | 2.75 | 35.00 |

**Notes**

- A largest card payment of 0.00 means that card is not accepted.
- The card convenience fee and the returned payment fee are each booked on the file as an option line.
- Card is listed among the accepted methods only for Studio Essentials, Studio Classic and Studio Select; wire is listed only for Studio Designer, Studio Signature and Studio Atelier.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a card payment of 4000.00 toward option deposits on a Studio Classic file is within the 5000.00 card limit, and the card convenience fee at 2.75 percent of 4000.00 is 110.00.
